contexts.text: Shechem the first station in Canaan...
Restore thee upon thy station () = that (these things) would be reduced into order, that they may be in the last place. AC 5241.
So shall your station be in the midst of the Natural... Signified.
A fixed state of spiritual life. Signified, Explained.
A stage in the succession. Signified.
They are removed successively from their former station...
The station where was the beginning of the course, that is, the starting point.
In such a position have I seen them...
Standings and sittings, being of man's rest, = the being of life from which is its manifestation; thus to cause to live.
